reviews.review:
I bought this game without expecting much but the game is actually better than I thought. 
The good: 
- The UI actually feel organized and clean.
- The game run pretty smooth. (which 90% of games like this don't have)
- Characters movement feel smooth. (still have some downside)
- Gameplay feel good enough for the price.

The bad: 
- Nudity tag is kind of misleading. (There are sexy outfit, but nowhere near nudity)
- Only have a few outfits for the protagonist. (Need more outfit, especially the "hot" ones)
- The game feel a bit empty. (I expected the next update would make it better)
- Need more weapons.

What I think could be good:
- More sexy outfit of course.
- More accessories.
- More hairstyles. 
- A button for dodging. (could make the combat feel smoother and better)
- Fill the game with more content. (since the gameplay already optimized enough)

My thought: The devs said the next update will add skills tree and more things so I going to wait and see. I thing the game is ok for its price.
